# Shimul Raj Das (Raj)

> Full-Stack Flutter Developer, Mobile Engineer (iOS & Android), UI/UX Designer, and AI Automation Specialist.

## Professional Summary
Shimul Raj Das is a Computer Science graduate, software engineer, and intelligent automation specialist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He specializes in building high-performance cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter and Dart, responsive web applications, and autonomous AI workflow pipelines using n8n and modern LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini).

## Core Competencies & Expertise

### 1. Cross-Platform Mobile App Development (Flutter & Dart)
- Native-grade mobile applications for iOS, Android, and Flutter Web.
- State Management: BLoC, Riverpod, Provider, GetX.
- Architectural Patterns: Clean Architecture, Repository Pattern, MVVM, SOLID principles.
- Backend & Cloud Integration: Firebase (Auth, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Messaging), Supabase, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets.
- App Publishing: Apple App Store and Google Play Console release management, CI/CD pipeline automation.

### 2. AI & Workflow Automation (n8n, Agents, Chatbots)
- Custom business workflow automation using self-hosted n8n, Make (Integromat), and Zapier.
- Multi-step AI agents and chatbots powered by OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Google Gemini.
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector databases, and semantic search.
- Web scraping, CRM integrations, and webhook automated data pipelines.

### 3. Full-Stack Web Development & UI/UX Design
- High-converting, responsive modern websites and web applications.
- Prototyping and design-to-code implementation from Figma and Adobe XD.
- Frontend: Flutter Web, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3.
